propositions: test_a_write_pushing_to_the_origin_leaves_no_detached_upkeep fails deterministically when run after test_push_callers_best_effort.py due to monkeypatch state pollution across test modules
test_push_callers_best_effort.py monkeypatches lock.canonical_tracker while event_append.write_and_push triggers the first import of ensures.py, capturing the patched lambda as a module-level binding

ensures.py's by-value import of canonical_tracker from lock persists the test's decoy path after the monkeypatch teardown, causing all downstream run_ensures calls to canonicalize trackers to a dead tmpdir

the victim test's tracker remains unpinned after init-time ensure sweep because its pins and .ensure-applied were written to the polluter's dead tmpdir, allowing git maintenance to spawn detached upkeep
the fix changes ensures.py to late-bind lock.canonical_tracker, write_lock, and LockTimeout via module-level import (from rebar._store import lock as _lock) instead of by-value capture
